module "P_Defaults.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_Defaults"
  pipeline order=0 injection=PostProcess.AfterTonemap views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  buffer "Late" RGBA8 resolution=Output scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  buffer "Early" RGBA8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  buffer "Both" RGBA8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1 export
  pass "Second" copy injection=PostProcess.AfterTonemap
    read SceneColor = SceneColor
    write Late = Late
  pass "Third" copy injection=PostProcess.AfterTonemap
    read Late = Late
    write Both = Both
  pass "First" copy injection=AfterOpaque
    read SceneColor = SceneColor
    write Early = Early
  pass "Fourth" copy injection=BeforePostProcess
    read Early = Early
    write Both = Both
